spiritgiven.comments: There were a lot of high fives and great spirts.

It yas great that both teams were able to have a lot of communication on field. Calls were solved smoothly and some of the coments that were made on the first half were solved during the second half of the game. Thank you for your respect and an exciting game!
Both teams had great energy, and despite the intensity of the plays, the spirit was positive throughout the game. Thank you for your patience(in terms of language difficulties) and respect!

There are multiple positive things. Although our Japanese team couldn't speak English very well, we could really feel their attitude and willingness to listen. They also always communicated slowly when they spoke English. And it was great to see them high-fiving and congratulating each other in between points.Thank you, New Zealand!

Thank you so much great attitude each other! That was really intense game, but we could do consistently calling while game. Japanese team couldn't speak English very well, we could really feel their attitude and willingness to listen. And also it was great to see them high-fiving and congratulating each other in between points. Thank you, team Germany!

Both teams played this game with good attitude, and when there were calls, they talked to each other. We had a lot of pick calls in the first half, but we were able to fix them in the second half, so that was good. And someone on your team was able to tell their opinion correctly and showed great fair-mindedness. Thank you, team Chinese Taipei!

Thank you for such a high level exciting game. Though it was an intence game, there were a lot of calm conversations on field and all of the calls were dealt cleanly. Thank you for your patience in term of discussion, despite our language difficulties.
This game was our second time playing against Chinese Taipei in this tournament, and same as the first time, it was a great game with good communication between the teams. Thank you!!
Thank you for such an exciting game. Your positive attitude inspired us a lot. There were some calls made from both teams but were solved cleanly thanks to your communication.

spiritreceived.comments: It was a very good communication on and outside the field:)

Thank you the game !! Great adaptation to our spirit point at half time - thank you. Great communication, and such a pleasant game to play. Thank you, thank you and amazing game !! (Sorry again for biting that 3m distance)
Calls were resolved in a timely manner even when requiring a translator. Positive game with lots of hi-fives, thanks!
Thank you for such a spirited game. Team Japan was very understanding and took on the perspective of our players even when it didn't benefit their team. They were very calm in all situations.
